{{Quote|Medical authorities from Coruscant, Raithal, and Rhinnal have gathered in a hospital frigate at the fringe of the system to study the plague, and determine whether any of the remaining Dentaallans might be saved. They do not have long to decide, say experts, since Dentaal will be an unpopulated wasteland within two weeks if the plague continues to spread at current rates.|[[Galaxy News Service]]|<ref name="NewsNets5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
The '''Dentaalians''' were the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] race that inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]]. They were all decimated during a [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] [[Dentaal Uprising|outbreak]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
